description: FIRE Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. When can you stop working? FIRE means you saved enough to live on, so work is a choice. We test your plan on real market years since 1928. It divides your yearly spending by the share you plan to take out each year. It runs your plan through every complete stretch of real US market years since 1928. It does not promise the money will last. The future can be worse than any past year. People ask for it as "fire calculator", "fire number calculator" or "what is my fire number".

later.description: Spending each year after you stop. US dollars. Leave empty if it stays the same. Empty if left out.

pay.description: Take-home pay each year. US dollars. After tax. Add a partner’s pay too. Default: 75000.

saved.description: Money saved now. US dollars. Default: 50000.

spend.description: What you spend each year. US dollars. Default: 45000.

stocks.description: Share of savings in stocks. A percent: 5 means 5%. The rest is in US bonds. Default: 60.

wr.description: Share you take out each year. A percent: 5 means 5%. Most people use 4%. Default: 4.
